entries.title: Isaiah 6:1
segments: ¶In the year that king Uzziah died I saw also the Lord sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up, and his train filled the temple. {his...: or, the skirts thereof}

entries.title: Isaiah 6:2
segments: Above it stood the seraphims: each one had six wings; with twain he covered his face, and with twain he covered his feet, and with twain he did fly.

entries.title: Isaiah 6:3
segments: And one cried unto another, and said, Holy, holy, holy, [is] the LORD of hosts: the whole earth [is] full of his glory. {one...: Heb. this cried to this} {the whole...: Heb. his glory is the fulness of the whole earth}

words.text: . {one...: Heb. this cried to this} {the whole...: Heb. his glory is the fulness of the whole earth}

entries.title: Isaiah 6:4
segments: And the posts of the door moved at the voice of him that cried, and the house was filled with smoke. {door: Heb. thresholds}

entries.title: Isaiah 6:5
segments: ¶Then said I, Woe [is] me! for I am undone; because I [am] a man of unclean lips, and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips: for mine eyes have seen the King, the LORD of hosts. {undone: Heb. cut off}

entries.title: Isaiah 6:6
segments: Then flew one of the seraphims unto me, having a live coal in his hand, [which] he had taken with the tongs from off the altar: {having...: Heb. and in his hand a live coal}

words.text: unto me, having a live coal
: {having...: Heb. and in his hand a live coal}

entries.title: Isaiah 6:7
segments: And he laid [it] upon my mouth, and said, Lo, this hath touched thy lips; and thine iniquity is taken away, and thy sin purged. {laid...: Heb. caused it to touch}

entries.title: Isaiah 6:8
segments: Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here [am] I; send me. {Here...: Heb. behold me}

entries.title: Isaiah 6:9
segments: ¶And he said, Go, and tell this people, Hear ye indeed, but understand not; and see ye indeed, but perceive not. {indeed, but understand: or, without ceasing, etc: Heb. in hearing, etc}

words.text: not. {indeed, but understand: or, without ceasing, etc: Heb. in hearing, etc}

entries.title: Isaiah 6:10
segments: Make the heart of this people fat, and make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and convert, and be healed.

entries.title: Isaiah 6:11
segments: Then said I, Lord, how long? And he answered, Until the cities be wasted without inhabitant, and the houses without man, and the land be utterly desolate, {utterly...: Heb. desolate with desolation}

entries.title: Isaiah 6:12
segments: And the LORD have removed men far away, and [there be] a great forsaking in the midst of the land.

entries.title: Isaiah 6:13
segments: But yet in it [shall be] a tenth, and [it] shall return, and shall be eaten: as a teil tree, and as an oak, whose substance [is] in them, when they cast [their leaves: so] the holy seed [shall be] the substance thereof. {and it...: or, when it is returned, and hath been broused} {substance: or, stock, or, stem}

words.text: But yet in it [shall be] a tenth
thereof. {and it...: or, when it is returned, and hath been broused} {substance: or, stock, or, stem}
